name: The four states of nāda-yoga (HYP 4.69-77)

stages.name: ārambha
stages.description: the knot of Brahmā pierced; bliss from the void; tinkling sounds and the unstruck sound in the body

stages.name: ghaṭa
stages.description: the breath goes in the middle; posture firm; the knot of Viṣṇu pierced; a clashing (vimarda) and a kettledrum sound in the atiśūnya

stages.name: paricaya
stages.description: mardala sound in the sky; the great void; bliss of the natural state

stages.name: niṣpatti
stages.description: the knot of Rudra pierced; flute and vīṇā sounds; the mind becomes one, called rājayoga
